# Feature: One-time switch — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #27 (One-time switch) from Switches and Doors before it is used in real levels. Effect: works once, then breaks. Unique: the only irreversible switch. Useful: a configuration choice you cannot undo. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** works once, then breaks.

**So that** a configuration choice you cannot undo.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets One-time switch for the first time in its teaching room (mech-27-one-time-switch-room). Teaching moment: First room: a one-time switch whose door can be seen to be the room's exit, with a patroller outside it. A player who presses it as soon as they reach it, before they are ready to leave, opens the exit permanently and gives the patroller a way in, which teaches that an irreversible press is made last rather than first. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: The first press fires its linked door permanently and the switch breaks (sprite changes)
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It never resets, so placed far away it is also how you open a remote door, which is why remote switch was rejected as a duplicate

## Edge Cases & Rules

- It never resets, so placed far away it is also how you open a remote door, which is why remote switch was rejected as a duplicate
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees One-time switch's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-27-one-time-switch-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/switches-and-doors.yml mechanic #27.
